arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/t_flags.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:500]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:500])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
REQ = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}
FRAME=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]

def build(cases, channels, events=()):
    return base(cases=[{"name":n,"frames":FRAME,"expect":e} for n,e in cases], events=list(events),
                channels=[{"name":nm,"parts":[{"case":o,"data":(d.decode('latin-1') if isinstance(d,bytes) else d)} for o,d in parts]} for nm,parts in channels])

# unattributed owner
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[(None,REQ)])])))
check('unattributed req flags', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], ['unattributed'])
check('unattributed owner', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owner'], None)
check('unattributed owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [[None,len(REQ)]])
check('case missing_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])
check('case origin_count', r['cases'][0]['origin_count'], 0)

# mixed_owner
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT),('b',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ[:10]),('b',REQ[10:])])])))
q = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('mixed owners list', q['owners'], [['a',10],['b',len(REQ)-10]])
check('mixed req flags', q['flags'], ['mixed_owner'])
check('mixed owner first byte', q['owner'], 'a')
check('case mixed_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['mixed_origin'])
check('case b flags', r['cases'][1]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])

# identity mismatches
for label, req, expect in [('method',b'POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n',EXPECT),
                           ('target',REQ,{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h"}),
                           ('host',REQ,{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"other"})]:
    r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',expect)],[('e',[('a',req)])])))
    check('identity '+label, (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), (['identity'],['identity']))
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ)])])))
check('identity ok', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), ([], []))
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"H"})],[('e',[('a',REQ)])])))
check('host folding both sides', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), ([], []))
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHOST: H\r\n\r\n')])])))
check('request host folding', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), ([], []))

# extra across channels and within a channel
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e1',[('a',REQ)]),('e2',[('a',REQ)])])))
check('extra second channel', r['channels'][1]['requests'][0]['flags'], ['extra'])
check('extra first channel', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], [])
check('case extra_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])
check('case origin_count2', r['cases'][0]['origin_count'], 2)
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ+REQ)])])))
check('extra in channel', [q['flags'] for q in r['channels'][0]['requests']], [[],['extra']])

# unsent
doc = build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ)])])
doc['cases'][0]['frames'] = [{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"g"}]
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('unsent datagram only', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), (['unsent'],['unsent_origin']))
doc = build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ)])])
doc['cases'][0]['frames'] = [{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":1}]
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('unsent sleep only', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), (['unsent'],['unsent_origin']))

# origin_count only counts the first-byte owner
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT),('b',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ[:5]),('b',REQ[5:]+REQ)])])))
check('count first byte', [c['origin_count'] for c in r['cases']], [1,1])
check('first byte b extra', r['channels'][0]['requests'][1]['owner'], 'b')

# merged equal non-adjacent labels
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT),('b',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ[:6]),('b',REQ[6:12]),('a',REQ[12:])])])))
check('merged equal labels', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',6+(len(REQ)-12)],['b',6]])
check('merged mixed', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], ['mixed_owner'])

# null owner in the middle
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ[:6]),(None,REQ[6:12]),('a',REQ[12:])])])))
q=r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('null middle owners', q['owners'], [['a',6+len(REQ)-12],[None,6]])
check('null middle flags', q['flags'], ['mixed_owner'])
check('null middle case flags', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['mixed_origin'])
check('null middle owner', q['owner'], 'a')
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[('e',[(None,REQ[:6]),('a',REQ[6:])])])))
q=r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('null first owner', (q['owner'],q['owners'],q['flags']), (None,[[None,6],['a',len(REQ)-6]],['mixed_owner','unattributed']))
check('null first case', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])

# per-owner extra ordering with several requests
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT),('b',EXPECT)],[('e',[('a',REQ),('a',REQ),('b',REQ)])])))
check('extra per owner', [q['flags'] for q in r['channels'][0]['requests']], [[],['extra'],[]])
check('origin counts3', [c['origin_count'] for c in r['cases']], [2,1])
check('case flags a2', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])

# token method expectation
r = run(json.dumps(build([("a",{"method":"G!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~0ET","target":"/","host":"h"})],
                         [('e',[("a",b"G!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~0ET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n")])])))
check('token method ok', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['cases'][0]['flags']), ([],[]))

# no capture at all
r = run(json.dumps(build([('a',EXPECT)],[])))
check('no capture no frames', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tests/t_flags.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -20
